card.text: 51 Peg b was found in 1995 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "51 Pegasi b"
sources.quote: 51 Pegasi b, officially named Dimidium, is an extrasolar planet approximately 50 light-years away in the Pegasus constellation.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around 51 Peg. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Cont et al. 2026's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "51 Pegasi b"
sources.quote: Dimidium was the first exoplanet to be discovered orbiting a main-sequence star, the Sun-like 51 Pegasi — a major astronomical discovery.
